violation_type.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))
violation_type.short_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation
violation_type.typical_finding: The director's files is incomplete and does not have proof of orientation, DL/ID, pre-affidavit, nor an signed affidavit.

finding_variants.text: The director's files is incomplete and does not have proof of orientation, DL/ID, pre-affidavit, nor an signed affidavit.
Based on the investigation findings, 3 new hires have not completed their orientation training within seven days of employment.
5 of the 8 staff files reviewed did not have documented proof of having completed orientation.    Proof of orientation was received for new staff and is now in compliance.
There were two caregivers hired on 2/06/24 and former caregiver without a verification of the Orientation received.

Two caregiver records was lacking documentation of pre-service and orientation training. Additionally, orientation was not completely conducted within 7 days of the employment date. One staff member is lacking orientation and a notarized affidavit of employment.
Orientation documents for 6 caregivers were not available.
